about_the_game:
What is Taskbarn?

Taskbarn is a cozy idle incremental game that lives quietly on your taskbar. Watch barn animals stroll, graze, and nap as they produce resources that transform into dibbles — the universal currency used to grow and improve your farm. Whether you’re working, browsing, or gaming, your barn keeps running in the background, always ready to welcome you back with progress!

Features

  • Idle on the Taskbar – The game is designed to run not only on your taskbar, but anywhere on your monitor, allowing it to blend right into your desktop workflow. The game can be freely moved, resized, and tucked wherever it fits best.

  • Fully Idle – No constant clicking required. Animals graze, nap, and generate dibbles automatically, even while you’re away. Just check in when you’re ready to spend your earnings!

  • Low-Impact Performance – Designed to be lightweight so you can run it in the background while doing other activities.

  • Collect & Upgrade Animals – Raise chickens, cows, ducks, sheep, pigs, and more. Each produces unique goods that fuel your farm’s growth.

  • Upgrade System – Improve productivity, grazing speed, and sleep recovery to keep your barn bustling.

  • Personalize Your Barn – Customize the look of your farm with plenty of options to fit your perfect vibe.

  • Play Your Way – Toggle individual visual elements on or off for a minimalist look or a fully decked-out farmstead.

  • Cozy Atmosphere – Gentle animations, warm audio, and a soft aesthetic bring lots of charm to your desktop.
